outcome: Experiment revision workflow is coherent end to end
owner_impact: The Lab now treats revision history as one consistent workflow: edits autosave into an unnumbered Working copy, numbered revisions remain immutable and selectable, AI revisions can arrive without hiding human work, Save Revision crystallizes the next chronological revision, and All/Mine/AI makes recovery of your own work immediate. Historical read-only revisions now copy the exact revision being viewed, human provenance is shown as Mine/Human rather than exposing a profile identity, and the revision UI has clearer labels, focus return and deliberate mobile touch targets.

next.text: The approved #396 Working-copy and navigable revision-history mini-epic is complete and should close. No owner action is required; the finished workflow is available in the live Lab. Future revision/collaboration changes belong to later evidence-driven UI/UX work rather than an automatic successor.

technical_evidence: A rollback-only production database scenario verified that a Working copy can remain based on an older retained revision while AI advances the head, then crystallize as the next chronological revision with the older base provenance preserved.

The same rollback scenario verified that a Professor can copy an older retained student revision after the student head advances, with copied artifacts, description and immutable provenance matching the requested retained revision exactly.
The copy RPC keeps its existing current-source authorization boundary: public visibility, explicit read-only share, or Professor supervision of a student Experiment.
Working-copy autosave now preserves title/description from the selected historical base rather than silently borrowing metadata from a newer head.
Human revision attribution is Mine for the signed-in account and Human for another person; AI attribution can still identify the authorized AI client.
The revision dialog exposes aria-expanded/aria-labelledby state and returns focus to the revision launcher when closed; mobile revision/history controls use deliberate touch targets.
Visible revision metadata uses Working copy / Revision Rn language rather than registry jargon.
No CI/CD, deployment, polling, retry, timeout, scheduling, connector-tool surface, scientific runtime, or project-development workflow rule changed.

The Experiment finder now explicitly keeps its collection-filter container hidden from primary navigation, matching the established responsive UX contract instead of depending on surrounding UI timing.

The Experiment finder explicitly unhides collection filters only while its dialog is open and re-hides them on every dialog close path, completing the secondary-navigation boundary verified by the responsive production smoke.
